biography.value:
Description

Kefka told Leo he was here on Gestahl's orders and killed the espers and seized their magicite, and then ordered his troops to burn the town. Leo fought Kefka to stop him, and Kefka vanished and called for Emperor Gestahl. Gestahl seemed to appear before Leo and admitted his true goal was to acquire power, but Gestahl then turned into Kefka, who revealed Leo had been fighting and speaking with illusions. Kefka pushed Leo to the ground and leapt on top of him and killed him.

Defense

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 10 (+3 dex, +1 deflect)

hp 150 [200] (10d6+40)

mp 67

Fort +11, Ref +10, Will +10

Immune Berserk, Blind, Confuse, Death, Doom, Mini, Petrification/Statue, Poison, Sap, Silence, Sleep, Zombie;

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee Mwk Morningstar +6 (1d8/x2)

Ranged +1 Dbl Chrg Power Staff: Lightning +9 (2d6+9)

Special Abilities Doublecast (1/day), Elemental Shield 10 (11/day), Elemental Seal (2/day), Innate Spells (1/day each) [Mage Amor, Thundara] Metamagic Enhancement (3/day)

Limit Breaks Mana Wall, Spell Fury

Spells Known (Black Mage CL 10th, concentration +18)

0th (DC 19) - Alter Food, Alter Object, Daze, Elemental Orb, Grab, Ignite, Mending, Message

1st (DC 20) - Blizzard, Dark, Icicle Dagger, Enduring Elements, Enfeeblement, Mage Armor, Ruin, Shield, Shocking Grasp, Slick, Spark, Thunder, Water

2nd (DC 21) - Blizzard II, Icy Breath, Poison, Thunder II

3rd (DC 22) - Bio, Blizzara, Thundara, Thunder III

4th (DC 23) - Ball Lightning, Poisonga, Ruinra, Thunder IV

5th (DC 24) - Blizzaga, Drain, Shock, Thundaga

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 26, Wis 16, Cha 10

Base Atk +5; CMB +13; CMD 26

Feats Extra MP, Empower Spell, Improved Initiative, Intensified Spell, Point-Blank Shot, Simple Weapon Proficiency

Skills Appraise +17, Knowledge (arcana) +22, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +22, Knowledge (geography) +22, Knowledge (history) +22, Knowledge (local) +22, Knowledge (planes) +22, Knowledge (technology) +22, Perception +9, Spellcraft +17

Languages Crazy, Common, 8 more

SQ Arcane Knowledge, Black Magery (Increased Damage +2, Spell Mastery +1), Mage Talent (Creative Destruction, Empowered Magic, Extended Magic, Knowledge is Power, Spell Lore), Clear Mind, Dark Affliction, Focused Caster, Spell Proficiency
